intel.title: [CISA KEV] BerriAI LiteLLM - BerriAI LiteLLM Improper Authentication Vulnerability
intel.raw_content:
CVE: CVE-2026-59822
廠商: BerriAI
產品: LiteLLM
漏洞名稱: BerriAI LiteLLM Improper Authentication Vulnerability
說明: BerriAI LiteLLM contains an improper authentication vulnerability in the MCP Streamable HTTP endpoint that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to establish an authenticated MCP session using an arbitrary Bearer token.
CISA 要求措施: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.
修補截止日: 2026-09-16
已知勒索軟體利用: Unknown

analysis.summary: CISA KEV 公布了 BerriAI LiteLLM 的身分驗證繞過漏洞（CVE-2026-59822）。該漏洞存在於 MCP Streamable HTTP 端點中，允許未授權的攻擊者使用任意 Bearer 憑證建立已授權的 MCP 工作階段，進而控制相關服務。
analysis.recommendation: 公司資產清冊未包含受影響資產，無需處置。

intel.title: [CISA KEV] Kludex Starlette - Kludex Starlette HTTP Request/Response Smuggling Vulnerability
intel.raw_content:
CVE: CVE-2026-48710
廠商: Kludex
產品: Starlette
漏洞名稱: Kludex Starlette HTTP Request/Response Smuggling Vulnerability
說明: Kludex Starlette contains a HTTP request/response smuggling vulnerability that could allow attackers to inject paths into the host part, prepending the actual path leading to issues such as authentication bypass when the authentication depends on the reconstructed URL’s path. This vulnerability could be chaned with CVE-2026-42271.
CISA 要求措施: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.
修補截止日: 2026-09-16
已知勒索軟體利用: Unknown
reference_urls: This vulnerability affects an open-source component, third-party library, protocol, or proprietary implementation that could be used by different products. For more information, please see: https://github.com/Kludex/starlette/security/advisories/GHSA-86qp-5c8j-p5mr ; BOD 26-04: https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/directives/bod-26-04-prioritizing-security-updates-based-risk ; Forensics Triage Requirements: https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/directives/bod-26-04-implementation-guidance-prioritizing-security-updates-based-risk ; https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-48710

analysis.summary: Kludex Starlette 存在 HTTP 請求/回應走私漏洞（CVE-2026-48710），已被 CISA 列入已知利用漏洞清單（KEV）。攻擊者可藉此繞過基於 URL 路徑重構的身份驗證機制，與其他漏洞串聯可能造成更大危害。
analysis.recommendation: 請開發團隊（KC00）針對「產品程式碼」進行相依性排查，確認是否使用 Python Starlette 庫。若有使用，應儘速升級 Starlette 至最新安全版本（參考 GitHub 安全公告 GHSA-86qp-5c8j-p5mr 建議之修補版本），或調整架構以避免單純依賴重建的 URL 路徑進行權限控管。

Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. reference_urls: This vulnerability affects an open-source component, third-party library, protocol, or proprietary implementation that could be used by different products. analysis.recommendation: 公司資產清冊未包含受影響資產，無需處置。

intel.title: [CISA KEV] Sangoma Switchvox - Sangoma Switchvox SQL Injection Vulnerability
intel.raw_content:
CVE: CVE-2026-9586
廠商: Sangoma
產品: Switchvox
漏洞名稱: Sangoma Switchvox SQL Injection Vulnerability
說明: Sangoma Switchvox contains a SQL injection vulnerability which allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary SQL statements against the backend PostgreSQL database using a single crafted request, including database operations and remote code execution.
CISA 要求措施: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.
修補截止日: 2026-09-05
已知勒索軟體利用: Unknown

analysis.summary: 此威脅涉及 Sangoma Switchvox 的 SQL 注入漏洞（CVE-2026-9586），遠端且未經授權的攻擊者可藉此發送惡意請求以執行任意 SQL 指令，進而導致資料庫操作與遠端程式碼執行（RCE）。目前該漏洞已被列入 CISA KEV 漏洞名冊，顯示已有活躍的攻擊活動。
analysis.recommendation: 公司資產清冊未包含受影響資產，無需處置。
